  Title guidance: Use a clean, coherent sentence with NO prefixes.
  Good: "Add retry handling for expired paused subscriptions"
  Bad:  "feat(cron): ...", "fix: ...", "chore: ...", "[Feature] ..."

  Branch flow: feat/* -> dev (junction, no CI) -> staging (CI) -> main (CI)
  AI agents: ONLY create feat/* -> dev, never merge. Humans merge all.
-->

## Promotion Path (required - check one)

- [ ] Feature branch -> `dev` (junction, **no CI** - AI and humans, AI ONLY this path)
- [ ] `dev` -> `staging` (human integration, **CI will run**)
- [ ] `staging` -> `main` (human release, **CI will run**)

> AI agents must check the first box only. `dev -> staging` and `staging -> main` are human-only promotion PRs.

## Checklist

- [ ] Title is a clean, coherent sentence with no `feat`/`fix`/`chore` prefix and no brackets
- [ ] Branch is correctly targeted per Promotion Path above (AI: `feat/*` must target `dev`)
- [ ] Linked the issue with `Closes #` or `Related #`
- [ ] Searched open and closed PRs for duplicates and found none
- [ ] No secrets or env values committed
- [ ] Documentation updated if needed

## AI Disclosure (required if any part was generated by an AI agent)

<!-- Delete this section if the PR is fully human-authored -->

- Agent: <!-- e.g., opencode / cursor / copilot -->
- Model: <!-- e.g., muse-spark-1.2 -->
- Task / Prompt ID:
- Human reviewer: @<!-- username who approved AI output -->

## Human Merge Checklist (for the merger only - AI must not merge)

- [ ] Promotion path is correct for this stage
- [ ] Review approved by CODEOWNER or maintainer
- [ ] For `feat -> dev`: local checks were evidenced above (CI does not run on `dev`)
- [ ] For `dev -> staging` / `staging -> main`: CI is green on the target branch
- [ ] Merged by a human (never by an AI agent)
